title: HORATIO
html_source: Horatio is a character in William Shakespeare’s tragedy Hamlet. Horatio is present through most of the major scenes of the play, but Hamlet is usually the only person to acknowledge that he is present; when other characters address him (except in I.i), they are almost always telling him to leave.
